aboutA:
I build trading systems and the software around them, end to end. CEO of Marketmaker.cc (scalping terminal, market data warehouse and backtesting for crypto traders) and CTO of Cmdop.com (remote server management through AI agents).

I have traded since 2011 and written software professionally since 2006, so I work on both sides of a trading product: the market logic and the code that runs it.

Trading and quant
- Scalping terminal for 60+ exchanges with a tick-level backtester that replays live-bot behavior
- Strategy search with Optuna (TPE, CMA-ES) on 50+ threads; a 3-node cluster with an in-memory cache made backtests 26x faster
- Arbitrage, scalping, market making, trend and portfolio strategies; own adapters to 30 exchanges plus about 100 via CCXT; order placement under 1 ms
- Open-source trading terminal profitmaker: 365 stars on GitHub

AI and automation
- Cmdop: agent control, chat bots for Telegram, Discord and Slack, browser automation
- Daily work with Claude Code, Codex and MCP servers; open-source tools gaia and aicommit

Blockchain
- Built a DEX from scratch (Solidity, web3.js) and an ICO analytics platform; launched a Cosmos SDK chain
- 1st place at BlockchainHack 2017 and at the waves.tech hackathon 2016

Web and products
- Six years running my own web studio, about 200 sites, full cycle from design to DevOps
- TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust; React, Next.js, Vue, Astro; PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, QuestDB; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform

Based in Batumi, Georgia. I also take on site and video production: suenot.com/production

Telegram: t.me/suenot · GitHub: github.com/suenot · Site: suenot.com
aboutB:
Trader since 2011, engineer since 2006. I build trading platforms and AI tools and take them from the first sketch to production myself.

Today I run Marketmaker.cc, a scalping terminal with a tick-level backtester and a historical market data warehouse for crypto traders, and I am CTO and partner at Cmdop.com, where AI agents manage remote servers.

Before that I ran a web studio for six years (about 200 sites), built an open-source trading terminal for 130+ exchanges, a DEX and an ICO analytics platform, and worked as a full-stack developer at Deep.foundation and Shakeapp. Three hackathon first places along the way.

I work in TypeScript, Python, Go and Rust, and build with Claude Code and Codex every day.

Batumi, Georgia. Telegram: t.me/suenot
